scope: External research-workbench audit of the Felt and GIS Cloud connectors. Research only; no production change.

felt.gate: Felt AI isn't enabled for the "Alec" workspace, so creating and analyzing maps through Felt's MCP server isn't available. Felt AI is available on Felt's Enterprise plans.

gis_cloud.spatial_sql: PostGIS st_* allowlist over PostgreSQL, storage SRID 4326, geometry column wkb_geometry, pk ogc_fid
gis_cloud.wms_wmts_wfs_tms: platform supports; CONNECTOR DOES NOT — Map Editor only

ca_landfalls.content: every Hawaii landfall in the archive

ca_genesis_band.content: genesis points 0-650 km of 12.0N 143.7W, months 7-9, season >= 1971

findings.claim: Atlas Hawaii landfall-region attribution is independently confirmed by PostGIS; zero substantive discrepancies.
findings.method: LEFT JOIN ca_landfalls to ca_coast ON ST_Intersects; then INNER JOIN on isl_name = atlas_sub_region measuring ST_Distance(::geography).
findings.interpretation: The 6 NULLs are boundary-coincidence artefacts: segment_crossing positions ARE the coastline intercept and lie on the ring. Not errors.
findings.warning: A naive ST_Intersects reimplementation of the landfall rule silently drops 6/19 Hawaii landfalls (32%), including Iniki 1992 — the only modern Hawaii hurricane landfall.

findings.claim: Spherical haversine (Atlas, R=6371.0088) vs WGS84 ellipsoid (PostGIS geography) differ by -1.80 km to +0.69 km at 0-650 km; no cohort membership flips.
findings.interpretation: Documented definitional sensitivity, not a discrepancy. Sign is bearing-dependent, not monotonic.

findings.claim: PostGIS geography and the Atlas's unwrapped-longitude representation are mutually incompatible at the antimeridian.

tests.geog_from_unwrapped_LINESTRING_179.9_180: ERROR: Coordinate values are out of range [-180 -90, 180 90] for GEOGRAPHY type

rules: Use ::geography, never planar geometry, for any track/region predicate.
Wrap into [-180,180] before casting; geography rejects unwrapped input.
The Atlas's unwrapping is load-bearing and does a job geography cannot do.

findings.claim: Two-C cohort closest-approach distribution to the eight named Hawaiian islands.
findings.status: historical counts and distances only; NOT a forecast and does not decompose into one

findings.claim: 48.7% of Atlas track points are interpolated and are drawn identically to observed fixes.
findings.note: archive.ptQuality / qObserved / qInterpolated / qProvisional are already decoded client-side (engine/archive.js:54-58) and unused by the renderer.

findings.claim: 30% of landfall marks are derived by straight-line segment crossing and are drawn identically to authoritative NHC L-records.
findings.note: geo.py's own text treats ~45 km as the credibility limit for a segment_crossing. Iniki sits 4 km inside it.

findings.claim: 744 of 3959 storms carry a pre-genesis track portion drawn identically to the post-genesis track.
